purpose: Test whether a protagonist creates long-horizon reader desire independent of profession, opening event, generic status gain or task escalation.

mandatory_attacks.REMOVE_PROFESSION: If occupation/genre task is removed, the magnet must remain.
mandatory_attacks.SWAP_PROTAGONIST: If another competent protagonist can inherit the same magnet with little loss, FAIL.
mandatory_attacks.FIFTY_CHAPTER_REPETITION: The pleasure must generate variation and escalation for 50 chapters rather than repeat one loop mechanically.

forbidden_shortcuts: generic face-slapping/revenge/rise-to-power as magnet without person-specific contradiction
opening mystery as substitute for protagonist desire
